CompositeOT.solver¶

Public CompositeOT solve entry point.

solve is the high-level routine used by CompositeOTProblem.solve and CompositeOTModel.solve. It always scales the problem internally, optionally runs SGS-ADMM for a first-order warm start, and finishes with PALM for high-accuracy termination.

Functions

solve(problem[, palm_options, admm_options, ...])

Solve a CompositeOT problem.

solve_scaled(problem, palm_options, admm_options)

Solve an already scaled problem.
